items.title: Google Is Spending $17 Billion on a Wyoming Data Center and Says It Will Pay for 100% of Its Power
items.summary: Google just answered the loudest objection to AI data centers, yet the market barely noticed and one key supplier tumbled. The fine print on who supplies the power, and what the pledge leaves out, may matter more than the headline.

items.title: Bloom Energy Rises 2%, AMD Up 8% as AI Stocks Rebound From Midterm Rout
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBloom Energy rose 2% today as AI stocks, AMD among them, bounced back from Thursday’s post-midterm selloff. Bloom had just landed a 900-megawatt NTT DATA deal and a 1-gigawatt plan with California Resources.

items.title: Is Bloom Energy (BE) A Bargain Following Election Driven AI Data Center Fears?
items.summary: Bloom Energy (BE) is back in focus after a sharp pullback tied to US election results increased concern about future AI data center approvals, even as the business continues to sign large fuel cell deals. The sharp election driven selloff means Bloom Energy’s share price has dropped 16.4% in the past day and 43.4% over the past month, yet it still carries a 69.7% year to date share price gain and a 3 year total shareholder return above 14x. items.title: Bloom Energy Sinks 16% Despite 900 MW NTT DATA Deal as Midterm Fears Hit AI Power Stocks
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBloom Energy fell 16% today, even after NTT DATA agreed to deploy 900 megawatts of Bloom’s onsite power. Investors fear Democrats’ win in Congress could stall the data-center buildout, and they sold the AI power trade, GE Vernova and Oklo included.
